enabled.description: Create this ExternalSecret when true. Accepts a Helm `tpl` string that renders to `true` or `false`.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix the name of the ExternalSecret with the chart fullname.

namespace.description: Namespace to create this object in. Overrides the chart-wide `namespace` and `global.namespace`.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels

refreshInterval.description: How often the data is synced from the provider, as a duration, eg `1h`. Supports Helm `tpl`. Uses the default of the External Secrets Operator when empty.

refreshPolicy.description: When the data is synced from the provider. Uses the default of the External Secrets Operator when empty.

name.description: Name of the SecretStore or ClusterSecretStore. Supports Helm `tpl`.

kind.description: Kind of the store the data is fetched from.

secretStoreRef.description: The store the data is fetched from.

name.description: Name of the Secret the External Secrets Operator creates. Supports Helm `tpl`. Defaults to the name of the ExternalSecret.

creationPolicy.description: How the External Secrets Operator creates and owns the Secret.

deletionPolicy.description: What happens to the Secret when the data is removed from the provider.

type.description: Type of the created Secret, eg `Opaque`.

engineVersion.description: Version of the template engine of the External Secrets Operator, eg `v2`.

mergePolicy.description: How the template is merged with the fetched data, eg `Replace` or `Merge`.

data.description: Keys of the created Secret, keyed by name. Values are Go templates evaluated by the External Secrets Operator.

items.description: A ConfigMap or Secret to load templates from, passed on as is.

templateFrom.description: Templates loaded from ConfigMaps or Secrets, passed on as is.

template.description: Template for the created Secret, passed as is. External Secrets Operator evaluates its own Go templates in here.

target.description: The Kubernetes Secret created by the External Secrets Operator.

key.description: Key of the data in the provider.

property.description: Property of the provider data to use, when the data is a JSON or YAML document.

version.description: Version of the provider data to use.

conversionStrategy.description: How the provider data is converted, for example `Default` or `Unicode`.

decodingStrategy.description: How the provider data is decoded, for example `None`, `Base64`, `Base64URL` or `Auto`.

metadataPolicy.description: Fetch the metadata of the provider data instead, for example `None` or `Fetch`.

remoteRef.description: Reference to the data in the provider.

sourceRef.description: Override the store for this key, passed as is.

additionalProperties.description: A setting of the store reference, passed on as is.

items.description: A single key to fetch from the provider.

data.description: Individual keys to fetch from the provider, supports Helm `tpl`.

key.description: Key of the entry in the provider.

property.description: Property of the entry to extract.

conversionStrategy.description: How the keys are converted, passed on as is, eg `Default` or `Unicode`.

decodingStrategy.description: How the values are decoded, passed on as is, eg `None`, `Base64`, `Base64URL` or `Auto`.

metadataPolicy.description: Whether to fetch the metadata of the entry, eg `None` or `Fetch`.

extract.description: Extract all keys from a single provider entry.

find.description: Find provider entries by name or tags, passed on as is.

additionalProperties.description: A setting of the search, passed on as is.

source.description: Regular expression to match the keys.

regexp.description: Rewrite the keys with a regular expression.

template.description: Go template that gets the key as `.value`.

transform.description: Rewrite the keys with a template.

items.description: A rule that rewrites the keys of the fetched data, either with `regexp` or with `transform`.

rewrite.description: Rewrite the keys of the fetched data.

sourceRef.description: Override the store for this entry, passed as is.

additionalProperties.description: A setting of the store reference, passed on as is.

items.description: A set of keys to fetch from the provider at once.

dataFrom.description: Fetch multiple keys from the provider at once, passed as is. External Secrets Operator evaluates its own Go templates in rewrite transforms.

description: ExternalSecrets, keyed by name. The External Secrets Operator syncs them into Secrets from an external store.
